Guidance & outlook: Our target for the full year still remains at 20 -22% of the opening assets.
We had initially launched with a target of INR3,000 crores.

And the target is to deploy about 70% of the AUM in the next maybe 2-3 months so that by end of Q3, we can launch the second fund, which we want to have around INR4,000 to INR5,000 crores again, slightly different strategy from the current one, but in the same space.
Growth & demand: The book has now crossed INR5,000 crores, lending book and NII growth was also about 12% Q-on-Q.
Full year basis, the ARR assets grew by about 20% to INR58,000 crores and net new money into managed accounts continue to remain strong at about INR1,800 crores.
Coming to the overall revenue, our revenue was at INR909 crores which is an 18% growth.
Margins & costs: Overall, ARR flows this quarter was slightly soft on net basis at ~INR1,000 crores because we are in the process of weeding out some extremely low-cost mandates, which were acquired long, long back.
Right now, our cost run rate is between INR30 crores to INR33 crores a quarter.
On the cost side, you will see that the quarter 1 cost has gone up by 19% and within that employee cost has increased by 17% and opex is up by 24%.
Capex & expansion: And to support this, we continue to invest in our talent ecosystem, which begins by hiring the right cohort, the right seniority.
We are deliberate and intentional in investing in technology and AI across the value chain, and this business, I think, will get the most of it.
So if I come to the employee cost which has grown by 17%, we have added almost 5% net capacity, net people over the last 1 year.
Balance sheet & cash: So about 30 -40 bps higher than this because like I mentioned in a few calls, our cost of debt basically moves a bit up and down because of the hedging gains and losses, which comes on our MLD book.
Our overall borrowing has about 25%, which is the MLD on which we keep hedging.
But for domestic debt capital markets or equity markets, the solution offering is today 100%.
Risks & challenges: I think I mentioned last time that this segment is seeing some intense competition.
I think there, we've seen some amount of volatility given the performance and also due to the launch of SIF 's, which is clearly a more superior tax vehicle.
And what is the absolute decline that you're seeing in the capital markets, if you can share that because your fixed income has grown 2x.

guidance.t: But on a full year basis, we are confident that revenue growth will be more than 20 -25% here.
